response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_records, COUNT(*) as total_projects
  FROM project_counts
),
with_calculations AS (
  SELECT pc.arcref, pc.record_count,
    pc.record_count::NUMERIC / tc.total_records as share,
    pc.record_count::NUMERIC / tc.total_records - 1.0 / tc.total_projects as deviation
  FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN totals tc
)
SELECT arcref, record_count, share, deviation
FROM with_calculations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The scanqc table contains at least one QC record; otherwise total_records and total_projects will be NULL, producing NULL results.
Average share is interpreted as 1 ÷ (number of distinct projects), the uniform expectation per project.
